visual_goal: Show the Lisbon booking travelling on two separate paths, money and records, that meet only at reconciliation and at the subledger-to-ledger tie-out.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration with two parallel tracks. The upper track is a money pipeline drawn as thick green pipes carrying coins: at the far left a plain generic office building labeled 'Provider', a pipe to a bank building labeled 'Bank', and a pipe on to a small house at the far right labeled 'Partner'. The lower track is a blue paper trail drawn as a conveyor of documents: at the far left a lightning-bolt box labeled 'Events', an arrow to a box labeled 'Subledger', an arrow to an open book labeled 'General ledger', an arrow to a stacked-layers box labeled 'Consolidation', and an arrow to a document stack at the far right labeled 'Filing'. The two tracks touch at only two meeting points, each drawn as a balance-scale icon on an orange background: one between the bank pipe and the general ledger, labeled 'Reconciliation', joined by one short arrow down from the bank and one short arrow up from the general ledger; and one small clasp between 'Subledger' and 'General ledger', labeled 'tie-out'.
alt: Money flows from the provider to the bank and on to the partner, while records flow from events through the subledger, general ledger and consolidation to filing; the two paths meet only at bank reconciliation and the subledger-to-ledger tie-out.

visual_goal: Show the booking spanning two periods and filings: cash in March, revenue in April, and the Q1 filing produced while the April period runs.
prompt: A horizontal timeline illustration on a ribbon from left to right, split into two coloured period bands: a teal band labeled 'March' on the left and an orange band labeled 'April' on the right. In the March band, coins dropping into a bank vault labeled 'cash' at '16 Mar'. Between the bands, a narrow grey gate labeled 'March close'. In the April band, a small hotel bed icon with a green upward arrow labeled 'revenue' at '21 Apr'. Below the ribbon, a lower row of three document stacks: 'Q1 10-Q', then 'Q2 10-Q', then '10-K' at the far right. One arrow from 'March close' down into 'Q1 10-Q'; one arrow from 'March close' forward into the April band; one arrow from the April band down into 'Q2 10-Q'; one arrow from 'Q2 10-Q' to '10-K'. The 'Q1 10-Q' document sits directly below the April band, showing it is filed while April runs.
alt: A timeline with cash arriving on 16 March and revenue on 21 April; the March close feeds the Q1 10-Q, filed during April, and April feeds the Q2 10-Q and later the 10-K.

visual_goal: Show three business chains converging on one consolidation, where only Stayloft passes through the group general ledger and the other two meet a mapping rule first at consolidation.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration with three horizontal lanes converging on the right. Top lane: a box 'Stayloft', an arrow to a box 'Subledger', an arrow to a large open book labeled 'Group ledger', then an arrow into a large stacked-layers hub at the right labeled 'Consolidation'. Middle lane: a box 'Tablekin', an arrow to an open book labeled 'Tablekin ledger', then an arrow through a small orange funnel labeled 'mapping' into 'Consolidation'. Bottom lane: a box 'Wayfare', an arrow to an open book labeled 'Wayfare ledger', then an arrow through a second small orange funnel labeled 'mapping' into 'Consolidation'. From 'Consolidation' one arrow to a document stack at the far right labeled 'Filings'. The top lane is drawn in blue, the two lower lanes in teal.
alt: Three chains converge on one consolidation: Stayloft through its subledger and the group ledger, Tablekin and Wayfare through their own ledgers and a mapping step, with consolidation feeding the filings.
